description: Processes for secure acquisition, use, management, and exit from cloud services are not established.
applicability: Applies when an organization uses cloud services but lacks established processes for securely acquiring, managing, and exiting cloud services, including assessment of cloud provider security, configuration management, and data protection throughout the cloud service lifecycle.

metadata.detection_notes: Review cloud service adoption processes, verify cloud provider security assessments, check cloud service agreements for security terms, assess cloud configuration management practices, examine data migration and exit strategies, review cloud access controls and monitoring.
